name: Math Sprint
description: 60 seconds of mental maths. Answer fast to chain combos and multiply your points, in three levels from sums to brackets.
prompt: A fast mental maths game: 60 seconds, four answer buttons, three levels from addition and subtraction to all four operations and brackets, combo multipliers for answers in a row, time penalty for mistakes and a best score per level.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: 60 segundos de cálculo mental. Responde rápido para encadenar combos y multiplicar tus puntos, en tres niveles de sumas a paréntesis.
